text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Petrimex a.s., an export-import company trading with petrcochemical products and materials, expects turnover of around 11 billion crowns this year, with exports accounting for about 65 percent of the turnover.

- The Slovak Statistical Bureau said that if the current demographic trend continues, Slovakia's population will begin to decrease in 2004, and that the population could decrease to some two million people in the year 2100, from the current 5.5 million.
- The Opposition Party of the Democratic Left (SDL) said it did support the idea of an early election next year.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Exports from Slovakia's sole oil refiner Slovnaft are expected to total some 17.3 billion crowns this year, up from last year's 15.6 billion crowns.
- Around 17,000 vessels went through the locks of the Gabcikovo dam on the river Danube this year, some 1,500 ships more than in the previous year.
